change.after: "the resources specified in a PolicyException populate matchConstraints.excludeResourceRules of the ValidatingAdmissionPolicy auto-generated from a validate.cel policy"

original.statement: Kyverno 1.13 now applies PolicyException declarations when auto-generating Kubernetes ValidatingAdmissionPolicies from Kyverno policies that use the validate.cel subrule, populating the generated policy's matchConstraints.excludeResourceRules with the excepted resources.

corrected.statement: Kyverno 1.13 adds support for PolicyException declarations when auto-generating ValidatingAdmissionPolicies from Kyverno policies that use validate.cel; the resources in the PolicyException populate matchConstraints.excludeResourceRules of the generated ValidatingAdmissionPolicy.

decision.reason: [ev-b9ece170da60] presents this as a new capability: "Kyverno 1.13 introduces the ability to leverage PolicyException declarations" when generating ValidatingAdmissionPolicies from validate.cel policies, so the resources in a PolicyException populate matchConstraints.excludeResourceRules. That matches "added", not "behavior-changed". The text never says the same configuration produced a different result before. The proposed "after" value is also a paraphrase, not a literal quoted from the text. The subject name is a reasonable kebab-case identifier built from the evidence's own words, so it is kept.
